Subject: Fulbright NZ Outreach Tour 2008

Fulbright New Zealand's educational advising team will be our campus as
part of their annual Outreach Tour to inform students and staff about
options for studying, researching and teaching in the United States of
America. Come along to hear unbiased, current and comprehensive
information on educational opportunities in the US and an introduction
to the Fulbright programme's range of awards to help you get there.

Fulbright New Zealand Outreach Tour 
Massey University Auckland
10:00-11:30am, Tuesday 20 May
Staff Lounge, Study Centre Building, 
Gate 1, East Precinct, Albany Expressway

See www.fulbright.org.nz for further information


Regards
Adeline Yap
Scholarships Officer
Massey Contact - Auckland
Extension 9072
